metadata.name: Marxism (classical Marx–Engels)
metadata.description: Classical Marx–Engels historical materialism and revolutionary workers’ politics, including transitional socialisation and the Commune interpretation.
metadata.scope: Classical historical materialism and revolutionary workers’ politics, including the Manifesto’s transitional programme and the later Commune interpretation. Later Leninist party-state doctrines are excluded. No incumbent government is treated as the direct embodiment of this historical doctrine. This is a sourced interpretation of the specified tradition, not an adherent questionnaire. Unresolved evidence or an unrepresented institutional premise is recorded as unknown, never as numerical neutrality. Historical sources are not treated as answers to modern technologies by analogy. Government acts are contextual evidence only, not a substitute for the scoped doctrine.
metadata.phrase: A society overcoming capitalist class domination through workers’ emancipation and common control of production.
